blocks.tamil_translation: and the reward of fasting for the whole year,” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Al-As (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُنْذِرِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ سَيِّدُ اْلاَيَّامِ وَأَعْظَمُهَا عِنْدَ اللهِ، وَهُوَ أَعْظَمُ عِنْدَ اللهِ مِنْ يَوْمِ اْلاَضْحَي وَيَوَمِ الْفِطْرِ، وَفِيهِ خَمْسُ خِلَالٍ: خَلَقَ اللهُ فِيهِ آدَمَ، وَأَهْبَطَ اللهُ فِيهِ آدَمَ إِلَي اْلاَرْضِ، وَفِيهِ تَوَفَّي اللهُ آدَمَ، وَفِيهِ سَاعَةٌ لَايَسْأَلُ اللهَ فِيهَا الْعَبْدُ شَيْئاً إِلَّا أَعْطَاهُ مَا لَمْ يَسْأَلْ حَرَاماً، وَفِيهِ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ، مَامِنْ مَلَكٍ مُقَرَّبٍ وَلَاسَمَاءٍ وَلَا أَرْضٍ وَلَارِيَاحٍ وَلَاجِبَالٍ وَلَا بَحْرٍ إِلَّا وَهُنَّ يُشْفِقْنَ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب في فضل الجمعة،رقم:١٠٨٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “The day of Jumu'ah is the chief of all days; that day is greater in Allah's sight than the other days, and that day is of higher rank in Allah's sight than the day of Eid-ul-Fitr and the day of Eid-ul-Adha. Five events took place on that day: on that day Allah created Adam (AS), on that same day He sent him down to the earth, on that same day He caused him to die, and on that day there is a particular hour in which, whatever the servant asks for, as long as he does not ask for something haram, Allah gives it to him. And it is on that day that the Day of Qiyamah will take place; all the angels who are close to Allah, and the heavens, the earth, the wind, the mountains and the sea all fear the day of Jumu'ah (because the destruction of the world will take place on the day of Jumu'ah),” Hazrat Abu Lubabah ibn Abdul Mundhir (RA) has narrated that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: لَا تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ
